landing.testimonial2Quote: I validated 3 ideas and picked the highest-scoring 'fitness check-in' direction. Got 200 seed users within two weeks of launch.
landing.testimonial3Quote: The competitor analysis was incredibly useful. It helped me find pain points competitors missed, which became my product's core selling point.
